VERSIONS.heading: Software Release: GC 4.0.0
subHeadings: Release Notes - General Commons – Version GC FE Version: 4.4.0

list: Cancer Data Service (CDS) Name Change to General Commons (GC) - The CDS name has been updated to GC for better alignment with the Commons naming conventions and user expectations
Change in Sequencing Search Terminology - Sequencing category has been updated to Genomic
Primary Diagnosis Search - A search functionality has been implemented on the Primary Diagnosis field, allowing users to quickly and easily find relevant data based on primary diagnosis.
Library Source CDE Split into two distinct fields: (1) Library Source Molecule (2) Library Source Material
This split allows for more precise data classification and improves clarity in library source tracking.
The User Guide has been updated to reflect the changes in the General Commons and instructions on how to navigate around
Donuts missing for File type – XLXS – implemented static donut
Footer - More Information section - External links should open in the same new tab
GC Home Page URL missing suffix "home"
